description: Takes a trigger in and puts one out again after a delay, as a gate of its own length

params.text: Sets how long after the incoming trigger the output fires, from 1.5ms to 2 seconds
Sets how long the output gate stays high, from 1ms to 1000ms; the panel prints TIME while the maker's tooltip calls it Gate time

inputs.text: Doubles the delay set by the DLAY knob per volt and halves it per volt below zero, up to a ceiling of 5 seconds
Starts the delay when it rises past 2V, and has to fall back below 0.1V before it will start another
Doubles the gate length set by the TIME knob per volt and halves it per volt below zero, held between 1ms and 5 seconds

outputs.text: Goes to 10V when the delay runs out and stays there for the gate length, then returns to 0V

notes: Retriggering during a delay can only lengthen it: a new delay is written in only when it is longer than the time left to run, and the gate length works the same.

inputs.1:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
